tool_args.rationale: The pilot has positive short-window gain and an adaptation signature, while the target horizon is far beyond the observed range. A slow-horizon probe distinguishes the archived reversal mechanisms and identifies their slow dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations confound the slow adaptation amplitude and timescale, making extrapolation to H = 21.9 unreliable.
Fine short-time trajectories do not directly resolve the long-horizon reversal.
It is irrelevant to the horizon ambiguity.
